messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: prod: encoder deployment (encoder:v2) reporting ~60% CrashLoopBackOff and rapid HPA scale events. Pager -> emily
emily: Got the page — looking. Seeing 5/12 encoder pods CrashLoopBackOff. Any recent deploys? :thinking:
jon: I rolled a canary 10m ago (encoder:v2) to 20% traffic. Observability shows memory spike on startup for the new image.
emily: grabbing logs now...
emily: ```kubectl -n prod logs encoder-v2-5f9f8 -c encoder
Exception: OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
...GC overhead limit exceeded...
```
sre_lead: HPA config looks wrong — targetCPU=5%? That would trigger extreme scaling on small bursts. Who applied the HPA?
jon: ugh, that was me. I reused the staging HPA and didn't update target. It's 5% instead of 50%.
emily: That explains the spin-up + evictions and OOMs. Customers seeing 500s and timeouts.
katy: Product impact: multiple enterprise customers reported degraded inference (timeouts, partial responses). CS already triaged a few tickets.
jon: I'm initiating rollback of the canary and will flip the feature flag to cut v2 traffic.
emily: Quick plan: 1) flip feature flag to stop routing to v2, 2) scale encoder-v2 replicas to 0, 3) revert HPA to sane values, 4) confirm error/latency drop.
emily: @deploy-bot flip-flag flags/encoder_v2 false
deploy-bot: Feature flag flags/encoder_v2 set to false by emily :white_check_mark:
ops_bot: Triggering rollback rollout: setting deployment image -> encoder:v1 and scaling v2 to 0
jon: Applying rollback manifest now: `kubectl -n prod apply -f rollback/encoder-revert.yaml`
sre_lead: Also patching HPA: `kubectl -n prod patch hpa encoder -p '{"spec":{"targetCPUUtilizationPercentage":60}}'`
emily: Running scale: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy encoder-v2 --replicas=0`
emily: Verification: encoder-v2 pods terminating, traffic flows to v1. Watching errors/latency.
katy: Posting incident summary to status page: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/395123 (notifying affected customers)
jon: Leaving oncall in 20m — @emily can you hand off to me at 11:00? I'll keep an eye for the next hour and open a postmortem.
emily: Handoff accepted. Steps for next oncall (short):
  - keep flags/encoder_v2 false
  - confirm HPA targetCPU=60% and minReplicas sane
  - run a small canary (1 pod, low qps) with memory limits validated
  - add a pipeline guard: block HPA manifest promotion without a review
jon: Acknowledged. I'll open an immediate PR to lock targetCPU and add a lint rule.
emily: Incident mitigated — error rate back to baseline, latency recovering. I'll keep monitoring for 15m then clear pager. :eyes:
incident-bot: INCIDENT MERGED: mitigated — traffic reverted to encoder:v1, errors decreased to baseline. Auto-close in 1h if stable.
